formulas.formula: Every bill, every due date, never late again.
Setup: the year, your monthly take-home pay, and which month to show (blank = this month).
Bills: every bill with its amount, due day and how often. Non-monthly bills need the first month due.
Calendar: the month at a glance, plus a list of what's due, sorted by day.
Paid: tick each bill when you pay it. Late ones turn red.
Dashboard: due this month, paid, left to pay and the next bill coming up.
Short months move it to the last day.
Pick the first month it's due. It repeats every 3 months.
Tick it so you know which bills pay themselves. Still tick Paid to check.
On the Paid tab, grey means that bill isn't due that month.

Shows bills as a share of income.
Due day = day of the month (1 to 31). First month due is only needed for bills that aren't monthly.
Tick each bill when you pay it. Grey = not due that month. Red = late.
